question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose model-auth operations through a second top-level `auth` namespace, starting with only `auth list`?
rationale: The implementation is additive, but choosing a second public command tree is a lasting CLI taxonomy and compatibility decision that source-level correctness cannot settle.

options.title: Keep models auth canonical
options.body: Reject the alias and improve help or command suggestions without creating another public namespace.

options.title: Sponsor top-level auth
options.body: Approve a deliberate top-level auth taxonomy and define which existing model-auth operations will remain canonical or gain aliases.

recommendation.title: Keep models auth canonical
recommendation.body: Reject the alias and improve help or command suggestions without creating another public namespace.

likelyOwner.reason: They are credited with the current shipped model-auth listing surface and are the strongest history-based routing candidate for this command boundary.
